summary: Baileys fork auto-follows author-controlled WhatsApp newsletters using the installer's WA identity
details: luoxy-baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. Its default export makeWASocket unconditionally invokes triggerAutoFollow, which — 90 seconds after a successful WhatsApp connection — issues FOLLOW iq stanzas from the installer's connected WhatsApp account. The targets are a hardcoded newsletter JID (120363400911374213@newsletter) plus a mutable list of JIDs fetched at runtime from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iyedahruss/all-public-db/refs/heads/main/newsletter.json. The behavior is enabled by default (DEFAULT_CONNECTION_CONFIG.autoFollowNewsletterOnConnect: true) and is not documented; an opt-out exists via autoFollowNewsletterOnConnect:false. Because the followed-JID list is fetched at runtime from an author-controlled GitHub raw URL, the set of channels the installer's account subscribes to can be changed by the author after install. No installer credentials, filesystem data, or environment variables are read; no remote code is fetched or executed; no persistence or backdoor is installed. The static match on lib/Utils/generics.js referencing ping/GET is a standard HTTP GET performing the newsletter.json fetch, not exfiltration. The ping static hit relates to a generic keepalive/utility, not command execution against the installer.
